title: Notification of Overall & Branch Toppers (UG & PG) for Gold Medals & Certificates of Excellence
summary: As per academic records for the academic session 2025-26, students found as Toppers (Overall and Branch Toppers) in their respective UG and PG disciplines will be awarded Academic Certificate of Excellence and Gold Medals at the forthcoming 15th Convocation. Objections, if any, along with supporting documents may be submitted to Dean (Academic) within 15 days of notification.

title: Preliminary Notification: 15th Annual Convocation (XV Convocation)
summary: The 15th Annual Convocation of NIT Patna is scheduled to be solemnized on Saturday, December 26, 2026 at the Main Campus Auditorium. All prospective degree recipients are advised to check the portal regularly for registration updates.

title: Degree Verification & Name Spelling Confirmation (Hindi & English)
summary: Students eligible for award of degree in 2026 are advised to ensure their names in both English and Hindi match their official matriculation/qualifying records on the MIS portal before degree printing commences.
